notes: A new layout: move, open and close every section round the work area (left, right, top or bottom), pop the 3D view or UV preview into its own window, a slim icon toolbar and a notification bell for updates and exports. New Shapes: 33 shapes with warp and skew. Skew any graphic on the car. Pen tool: Ctrl for straight lines, Alt to lock the angle with a readout. Named colour swatches, an In-game look with clear coat reflections, and the option to add the body colour to the export. Exports carry the BLD badge in an empty part of the template.
